name: Pickle - Emergency Response
tagline: Emergency-only location sharing with friends, SMS updates and an AI survival assistant during disasters.

awards: Build an AI agent with Cohere

problem: In disasters like the Los Angeles wildfires, people cannot share their status and responders lack a picture of need.
solution: Location sharing that activates only in emergencies, anonymous heatmaps for responders, and an AI assistant reachable by SMS.
demo_moment: Team-described: trigger an emergency and see friends' statuses and a heatmap.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Build an AI agent with Cohere” among 134 submissions.
Privacy-preserving: shares location only during emergencies.
Timely: built during an ongoing disaster.

lessons: SMS reach plus privacy limits make an emergency tool believable.
